validation: PASS against original CharacterTable and SkillTables assets; the API is independent of native CharacterMenu VM, V6, canonical Character, and InitPost.
api: dh::foundation::generic_skills::PageV1 borrows the caller's CharacterState by reference and original CharacterTable/SkillTables; view resolves source rows, select tracks a class-list position, assign updates only the chosen SkillSlotBinding in that same state, train delegates to an explicit source progression/action provider.

row_authority.class_token: CharacterState.class_id must exactly match a name in the original CharacterTable.
row_authority.saved_override: When populated saved skill rows exactly match a different original SkillList, that row order becomes active; source-known slot state that matches no original SkillList fails closed. This allows actual saved-row overrides without imposing class_id-to-SkillTree equality.
row_authority.skill_position: Index in the active SkillList; each position maps to its original global SkillTable ID.
row_authority.saved_rank: Only an existing CharacterState::skills entry supplies rank. Exact ordered rows preserve source duplicates; otherwise unique ID mapping is required. Missing or ambiguous rank remains absent.
row_authority.saved_slot: Existing SkillSlotBinding::saved_skill_row indexes the same CharacterState::skills vector. No blank or default slots are synthesized. Assign requires an unambiguous existing saved row and writes only the addressed equipment set/source slot.

source_art_and_text.available: Raw original SkillIcon key, original skill dictionary token, SkillTable row, and signed RequiredLevel word 8 are exposed on each row. An optional localized_text provider can supply actual StringManager-derived name/description values for the same row and state.
source_art_and_text.not_claimed: This generic presenter does not translate SWF icon keys into geometry or synthesize localized descriptions. Existing original SWF geometry and native StringManager/AI descriptions remain upstream providers.

action_contract.assignment: Uses original two-equipment-set/three-source-slot bounds, SkillAssignable word 18 != -1, saved rank > 0, and mandatory same-state source availability callback. It mutates only the CharacterState skill_slots entry after all gates pass.
action_contract.training: Delegated because difficulty, level caps, available points and CanIncrementSkill are source-owner policy. Missing provider fails; false/throw restores the same CharacterState contents. No rank, cooldown, or point policy is fabricated.
action_contract.persistence: Changes are in-memory CharacterState updates only. Existing generic profile persistence can serialize this shared state; this feature does not claim the original whole-profile source save owner.

provider_gaps: Generic CharacterState has no explicit active GetCharSkillListId field. The page derives a saved override only when existing rows match an actual SkillList; if multiple identical authored lists exist, runtime source list identity cannot be distinguished, though row order is identical.
The generic model has no localized skill prose or rendered SWF geometry. Callers must supply StringManager text and art resolution where available.
Native progression training remains an explicit service because original availability/level-cap/potion side effects are not encoded by CharacterState plus SkillTables alone.

checks: all actual CharacterTable rows with supported SkillTree metadata
actual source SkillList position to SkillTable row/name/icon order
rank/points/slot projection from the same CharacterState without defaults
saved-row override selection independent of base class metadata
same-state slot assignment and same-state source training provider callback
source SkillAssignable/rank/availability rejection and no-change behavior
missing class token, unmatched source-known rows, absent text/rank/slot data remain explicit
failed source train provider restores the same state contents
